record.question: What was the feeling of the author about giving help to the English ?
options: Knowing how the British Government had been treating the Indians, helping them was the right thing to do.
Knowing how the British Government had been treating the Indians, no one would have agreed to give them any help.
Knowing how the British Government had been treating the Indians, all supported to help them.
Knowing how the British Government had been treating the Indians, he had no misgivings about helping them.
